> Would it be possible to wrap facets around a circle, instead of on a
> linear grid, as in CIRCOS output?  I feel like this is something that
> should be doable using ggplot, but isn't currently.

I had a quick look at CIRCOS on line, not being familiar with it.

There seem to be a number of different circular graphics presented
on their web site, so you might want to be more specific with your
query.

However, some of them may be achievable using coord_polar, which
puts the x-axis on a polar coordinates scale and is how, eg, ggplot
can be used to generate a pie chart. This seems much more like
what you want to do than 'wrap facets around a circle'.

I would suggest giving something a go, creating some kind of
reproducible example and raising a query on community.rstudio.com
forums which are far more active than this mailing list these days.

Regards,
Ron.
